title: The Machines That Build the Next Machines
claim_tested: Loss and restoration of physical infrastructure changes the availability of computation.
design: Primary: matched-service availability changes for preidentified Strasbourg versus unaffected facilities. Available secondary diagnostic: historical BGP-prefix visibility for OVH's entire ASN.
identification_limits: AS16276 includes many unaffected facilities; it is not a Strasbourg treatment indicator
BGP prefix counts are not server uptime or AI output
No service effect is estimated from the public ASN diagnostic
A physical dependency does not establish AI/data-center inevitability or a productive growth loop

asn_diagnostic.measurement_warning: Provider-wide prefix visibility is neither facility treatment nor hosted-service uptime; unchanged counts cannot refute an outage.

result.conclusion: A network-measurement feasibility check only unless facility-mapped service data are supplied.
